name: Organo Corporation
summary: Organo Corporation operates as a water treatment engineering company in Japan, Taiwan, the United States, China, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company engages in the manufacturing, sales, and maintenance of various water and wastewater treatment systems utilizing ion exchange resins, separation membranes, activated carbon, etc.; provision of water treatment outsourcing services; and sales of various water treatment chemicals and food processing materials.
